sources.entry: A Dark Room - Minimalist text adventure game for your browser. (Demo) MPL-2.0 Javascript

summary.one_liner: A Dark Room is a minimalist text adventure game that runs in the browser, listed under Games on awesome-selfhosted.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and describes the game as a minimalist text adventure played in a web browser, opening with the line "awake. head throbbing. vision blurry. come light the fire." It offers a click-to-play link and says the latest version can be played on GitHub. It lists translations in about two dozen languages, including Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese and Lithuanian. The README does not describe gameplay mechanics, and it does not document any self-hosting or server setup.
use_cases: play a browser-based text adventure game
casual minimalist game to play in a browser tab
play a text game in a non-English language
study a small JavaScript browser game
how_to_run: Click the 'Click to play' link in the README to play in the browser
Or play the latest version via the GitHub link in the README
notable: Minimalist text-based adventure with no graphics described in the README
Translated into roughly two dozen languages
caveats: README gives no installation or self-hosting instructions
README does not describe gameplay or technical architecture
